name: Anifusion
original_description: Create anime art, manga, and editable comics from your ideas. Design original characters, turn a story or your own panel script into a private comic draft, and generate artwork for a whole page or selected panels. Open your comic in Anifusion to refine layouts and lettering, then export page images. You can also create character sheets and videos, or use supported LoRAs for characters and styles. Explore available models and approve generation before it starts. Connect your Anifusion account to get started. Available workflows depend on your account permissions and supported models. Your creations are not automatically published to the community gallery.
